findings: Whole retrieval module read: dimensions, transformed row layout, physical density/aspect/offset conversions, color declarations, HDR metadata, ICC/Exif, palette/transparency, text/unknown chunks and user limits.

Pinned PNGv3 getters for gAMA/cHRM report actual stored chunks; missing declarations must not be inferred from a getter failure. cICP and sRGB have separate presence checks; this module does not itself perform color transformation or define overall precedence.

Several getters return borrowed info pointers; caller must honor owning png/info lifetime. Required output pointer contracts differ: cICP requires all four, ICC requires name/profile/length, while gAMA/cHRM permit optional output pointers. Not every getter accepts null outputs.

Physical pixel aspect returns y_pixels_per_unit/x_pixels_per_unit. Meter density getter additionally requires meter units; combined isotropic getter returns zero for unequal x/y density. Missing metadata and a zero value can share convenience return values.

tRNS validity query specially suppresses a canceled transparency chunk when num_trans is zero; raw retrieval behavior and presence query are distinct APIs. Existing own-library transparency tests remain separate evidence.
No production code changed, no additional runtime claim or native pHash.org/ASAN.
